channel.description: Recent content in News on Niloy Saha

item.title: Paper accepted in IEEE NOMS '22
item.description: Our paper “Demonstrating Network Slice KPI Monitoring in a 5G Testbed” is accepted in IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium (NOMS), to be held in Budapest, Hungary from April 25 - 29, 2022. Link to pdf.

item.title: Paper accepted in IEEE IoT Journal
item.description: Our paper “Q-Flag: QoS-Aware Flow-Rule Aggregation in Software-Defined IoT Networks” is accepted in the IEEE Internet of Things Journal. This work was done at the Smart Wireless Applications and Networking (SWAN) Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, India, under the guidance of Prof. Sudip Misra. Link to pdf.

item.title: Moved to Canada
item.description: I moved to Ontario, Canada and joined Prof. Raouf Boutaba's group at the University of Waterloo, where I will be working in the area of next-generation mobile networks.

item.title: Paper accepted at ACM FlexNets '21
item.description: Our paper “AI-driven Closed-loop Automation in 5G and beyond Mobile Networks” is accepted in ACM SIGCOMM Workshop on Flexible Networks Artificial Intelligence Supported Network Flexibility and Agility (FlexNets), to be held virtually from 23 - 27 August, 2021. Link to pdf.
